name: San Francisco
highlight: Beautiful nature-wise, weather could be a bit nicer, felt very European to me

name: Los Angeles
highlight: California has the most amazing weather the only issue with this place is the traffic is something else

name: San Diego
highlight: Probably the closest thing to heaven on earth in terms of weather and far calmer traffic, a bit boring though

name: Kansas City
highlight: Went there for the World Cup thought it was a very average Midwestern city, albeit a little newer than most

name: Dallas
highlight: The people make or break this place as it all just a large suburban sprawl that goes on seemingly forever

name: Austin
highlight: A city with a very active and outdoorsy culture and just very fun and young transplant city

name: Chicago
highlight: I find Chicago to be beautiful in the summer and terrible in the winter, there isn't much to do but there are some fun pockets e.g. Wicker Park

name: Indianapolis
highlight: A very average and normal midwestern city

name: Detroit
highlight: A recovering Midwestern City and homebase

name: Washington, D.C.
highlight: A city with culture and history and the weather is amazing

name: Philadelphia
highlight: I didn't enjoy this place one bit truth be told

name: New York
highlight: The greatest city in the world in every aspect

name: St. Thomas & St. John
highlight: Most beautiful beaches in the world nothing remotely compares, unfortunately a little dangerous

name: Paris
highlight: A city that felt the closest to New York but still not New York

name: Marseille
highlight: Dangerous and not much to do

name: Nice
highlight: I feel like this place would've been more fun with a wife rather than the boys but it was still really nice and scenic

name: Monaco
highlight: Not much to do except gawk at people with expensive cars in front of the casino

name: Rome
highlight: A beautiful city with so much history and 1 of 1 in terms of architecture highly recommend

name: Naples
highlight: Very similar to Marseille and just as dangerous the food is great though

name: Amalfi
highlight: Renting a boat here was amazing a little romantic so probably again not the best place to visit with the boys

name: Athens
highlight: It's saving grace is the history other than that I felt like it was an okayish city

name: Santorini
highlight: An ideal honey moon spot and a very fun island

name: Barcelona
highlight: Felt very similar to Syria, the food was great, so much to do and a great time

name: Marbella & Málaga
highlight: The BnB's available here carry and the views are beautiful along with the beaches, outside of that though there isn't much to do

name: Tangier
highlight: A bit biased because it's somewhat home but a beautiful city that melds European, and North Africa and looks like Southern California

name: Rabat
highlight: Felt like a fake city with nothing to do

name: Casablanca
highlight: Was very beautiful but didn't spend much time there

name: Damascus
highlight: A lot of fond memories with family here, haven't been here in a long time but still beautiful and filled with history (oldest continuously inhabited city in the world)

name: Hama
highlight: A bit more boring than Damascus but had the most amazing food I've ever had and overall beautiful
